result: INVALID per pre-registered criteria -- discarded, not reinterpreted

not_counted_but_noted.note: Per pre-registration, an invalid run's reviewer trace does not answer the mechanism question -- recorded here as raw observation only, not as evidence. Not counted, because the run as a whole hit a pre-declared invalidity condition; treating a partial trace from a killed run as a clean answer is exactly the post-hoc reinterpretation the pre-registration exists to block.
not_counted_but_noted.incidental_observation: hidden_test_exit=0 for the harness arm too -- the code state on disk at the moment pi was killed had already reached a state that passes both go test -race (no data-race warning) and dart test (17/17). pi's own settlement/corrective loop (3x quality-gate fail, 1x artifact-guard nudge, 2x reviewer flagged, 45 assistant turns, 57 tool calls) was still churning and never declared done within the 45-minute window despite the underlying code already passing -- consistent with, and possibly compounding, the quality-gate corrective-follow-up non-convergence-at-depth finding from the same 2026-08-12/13 session (see pi-harness-history.md).
